about: Save/resume of solo games against the AI: the exact strings, the launch rule and the prompt detail. At launch a saved game is offered iff resume.json and game.checkpoint both exist, now - (leftAt ?? lastCheckpointAt) <= windowSeconds, and appBuild and engineIdentity match the running app (an unknown format counts as a mismatch). Otherwise both files are deleted and the one-time notice is shown; a mismatch wins over expiry. A checkpoint without its sidecar was already abandoned and is deleted quietly. A sidecar without a checkpoint (the app closed before the first save) or an unreadable sidecar, and the in-progress marker of a game that cannot checkpoint, give the endedOnClose notice. Times are seconds before launch; leftAgo null means the app died in the foreground. The detail rounds seconds down to whole minutes. Read by ParityGoldenTests.swift; the Android port must meet every expectation.

strings.expired: Your unfinished game expired after 10 minutes.
strings.updated: Your unfinished game can't be resumed after an update.
strings.endedOnClose: Your last game ended when the app closed.
